sources.entry: Jobvetta - MCP server and API for searching current India jobs from official employer career pages by keyword, location, and posting age. #free

summary.name: Jobvetta Jobs API
summary.one_liner: A REST API and hosted MCP server that searches current India job listings gathered from official employer career pages.
use_cases: Building a job search product for India
Giving AI agents live India job search
Monitoring recently posted jobs by keyword and city
Research on India job market listings
summary.what_it_does: Jobvetta provides a REST API (GET /v1/jobs for search and GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} for details) over an index of India job listings drawn from employer career systems and official recruitment notices. Searches can filter by keyword, location, and posting age from 1 to 365 days, returning up to 10 results per request. Normalized records include titles, companies, locations, work models, employment types, dates, salaries when published, and source URLs. The page also lists official SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Go, Swift, and Java, and a hosted MCP server for AI tools. Authentication uses a single Bearer API key.
notable: Hosted MCP server so AI agents can search India jobs directly
Records keep the original application destination and source URL
Search by posting age window from 1 to 365 days
Maintained SDKs for five languages plus cURL examples
caveats: Free tier limited to 50 requests per key per UTC day
Search returns up to 10 results per request
Requires sign-up to create an API key
